ValidationRule.description: IM-76: Parent must be blank if Type contains root.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Foundation_Code_Validation__c && AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Initiative Root'), ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Non Initiative Root') ), NOT(ISBLANK( Parent__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Parent can not be set for Root Foundation Codes.
